mechanic.name: wonder capture moment (resonance to reveal)
mechanic.build: wonder_scanner v2 (commit after 02ec778), Vite dev + production build
mechanic.scene: scan screen, live camera or photo fallback, single detected object
mechanic.network_state: offline after model load; all simulation on-device
mechanic.camera: rear camera full-bleed video with 2D canvas overlay

goal: Make the capture moment a readable intention-to-consequence skill step (timing tap with graded outcome) and make the live camera view itself a playfield (AR spirits, aura, holo tag), without changing detection, cooldown, save schema truth, or blocking input.

baseline.capture: Chrome DevTools automation on 390x844 viewport with photo-fallback path; state read via window.__scan debug hook (mode, gauge, ring radius, grade) and localStorage.
observations: v1 capture was passive: gauge filled while holding still, then reveal fired with no player action; every capture produced identical presentation.
Bounding box jittered frame to frame, weakening the anchored feel of the bracket.
The camera view had nothing to interact with between detections.
inferred_stages: perceived responsiveness on real touch devices

response_chain.evidence: Player aims at an object, then taps when the shrinking ring meets the golden band.
Scripted pointerdown at ring radius 0.328 (target 0.30) produced grade PERFECT; at 0.90 produced MISS; at 0.46 produced GOOD.
Modes scan -> capture -> grade -> finish observed via debug hook; 3 cycles without tap resolved to AUTO.
localStorage after PERFECT: bestGrade PERFECT, stats.perfects 1, XP 20*1.5*1.5=45, dust 10*3*2=60; MISS incremented stats.misses and reset gauge to 0.48.
Smoothed bracket, aura particles scaled by gauge, holo tag, shrinking ring with golden band, grade burst text; screenshots v2-04/v2-05.
Grade flash color, chime on PERFECT, denied tone and haptic pattern on MISS, Lupe line changes per outcome.
After MISS mode returned to scan with gauge 0.48 and refilled to a second capture; after finish the scan loop stopped, camera released, reveal rendered.

primary_hypothesis.weak_link: simulation response: no player decision between resonance-full and reveal
primary_hypothesis.problem: Because the reveal fired automatically, the player had no moment of intention whose consequence they could read, so all captures felt equivalent regardless of skill.
primary_hypothesis.change: Insert a timing ring after the gauge fills: tap radius is graded PERFECT/GREAT/GOOD/MISS with continuous distance thresholds; MISS makes the wonder flee (gauge reset), grades scale rewards and variant odds. Detection, cooldown, and discovery bookkeeping are unchanged.
primary_hypothesis.expected_signal: Players can name their grade from the burst text and reward line, and repeat scans show different outcomes tied to their tap timing.
primary_hypothesis.falsifier: Grades feel random on real touch latency, or players cannot hit GOOD reliably, or the MISS flee reads as a bug.
primary_hypothesis.competing_explanation: The flat feel may have come from identical reveal presentation rather than the missing decision; addressed separately by grade-specific flash, chime and reward line.

channels: reward line x1.5 XP / x2 dust
event_channels.necessary_information: Tap landed inside the tightest window and rewards are multiplied.
event_channels.accessibility_alternative: With reduced motion the flash/shake are skipped; grade text, reward line and Lupe line remain. With auto-capture on, the ring is skipped entirely.

event_channels.necessary_information: The tap was outside the band; resonance must refill.
event_channels.accessibility_alternative: Text and gauge state carry the information without sound or haptics.

event_channels.necessary_information: Fragment count progressed toward a boost.
event_channels.accessibility_alternative: Counter and floating text carry the information; no camera motion involved.

safety.simulation_truth: Detection confidence, cooldown, codex bookkeeping, XP curve and save schema are unchanged; grades only multiply rewards and variant odds.
safety.input_policy: No input lock is added. A tap during the ring resolves immediately; taps outside capture mode route to spirits. Three ring cycles without a tap resolve to AUTO so no player is blocked.
safety.return_to_rest: Capture stops on finish, target loss (1.5s), and screen exit; overlay is cleared every frame; camera tracks are stopped in the route cleanup.

settings.behavior: Off path removes these while keeping grade text, reward line, Lupe text and stable brackets.
Skips the ring and captures at AUTO grade when the gauge fills.
Off removes vibration without removing visual or audio confirmation.

accessibility.redundant_signals: Grade outcome is carried by text, color, sound, haptic and the reward line; none is the sole channel.

comparison.control: v1 build (commit 02ec778): passive fill then automatic reveal.
comparison.variant: v2 build: same detection and fill, then timing ring with graded resolution, AR spirits and aura layered on the overlay.
matched_conditions: same balance constants for fill rate and cooldown
comparison.repetition_basis: Three captures (AUTO, PERFECT, MISS->GOOD) plus one spirit tap; each read back from state and DOM.
acceptance: Grades map to tap radius as specified and are visible in burst text and reward line.
MISS returns to scan with gauge 0.35..0.5 and a second capture succeeds.
AUTO resolves after 3 cycles without input.
Reduced-motion and auto-capture settings persist and are honored by fx.js and scan.js.
No console errors across title, scan, reveal, codex, quests, profile.

performance.budgets: Overlay draw must stay under one frame at 60 Hz on mid-range phones; detection loop is throttled to about 20 Hz.
performance.basis: Desktop Chrome automation only; real-device frame pacing not yet measured.
performance.measurement: Bundle: app 79 KB (32 KB gzip), TF chunk 274 KB gzip unchanged.

decisions.decision: Add a timing ring rather than more reveal effects.
decisions.basis: The missing stage was a player decision, not feedback volume.

decisions.decision: Treat AR as screen-space camera effects (gyro-anchored spirits, aura, holo tag) rather than world tracking.
decisions.basis: No WebXR; 3-DoF orientation is enough for look-around play and keeps the bundle static.

decisions.decision: Ship reduce-motion and auto-capture toggles with the effect.
decisions.basis: Timing rings and flashes are the largest new vestibular and skill demands.

route_out.reason: Touch latency for the PERFECT window and gyro permission flow on iOS were not measurable in desktop automation.
